<mxfile host="draw.io"> <diagram name="Ansible Pipeline" id="ansible-pipeline"> <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="900" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1800" pageHeight="700" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<!-- Entry Points --> <mxCell id="setup_py" value="setup-clusters.py" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="60" width="150" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="runner" value="ansible_runner.run()" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="130" width="150" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase boxes — horizontal flow --> <!-- Phase 1: localhost setup --> <mxCell id="p1" value="Phase 1
localhost" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="30" width="150" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1a" value="test_ansible_runner" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="40" width="130" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1b" value="setup_localhost" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="78" width="130" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase 2: provision --> <mxCell id="p2" value="Phase 2
proxmox" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="430" y="30" width="150" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2a" value="provision_infra
(strategy: free)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p2"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="40" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase 3-4: K8s setup --> <mxCell id="p34" value="Phase 3-4
k8s nodes" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="610" y="30" width="150" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3a" value="setup_cluster_master
(includes setup_os)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p34"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="38" width="130" height="32" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4a" value="setup_cluster_node
(includes setup_os)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p34"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="78" width="130" height="32" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase 5-7: PKI + CNI --> <mxCell id="p57" value="Phase 5-7
k8s nodes" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="30" width="150" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p5a" value="setup_pki" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p57"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="35" width="130" height="22" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p6a" value="distribute_pki" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p57"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="62" width="130" height="22" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p7a" value="bootstrap_cillium" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p57"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="89" width="130" height="22" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase 8-9: Optional --> <mxCell id="p89" value="Phase 8-9
optional" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="970" y="30" width="150" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p8a" value="bootstrap_istio
(ENABLE_ISTIO)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="p89"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="40" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p9a" value="bootstrap_nvidia
(ENABLE_CUDA)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="p89"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="80" width="130" height="30" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Phase 10-15: Platform bootstrap --> <mxCell id="p1015" value="Phase 10-15
localhost → K8s API" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="200" width="870" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p10a" value="bootstrap
argocd" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p11a" value="bootstrap
pki_secret" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="130" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p12a" value="bootstrap
harbor_secret" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p13a" value="bootstrap
rook / cephfs" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="370" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p14a" value="bootstrap
applications" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="490" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p15a" value="display CA
trust scripts" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="p1015"> <mxGeometry x="610" y="40" width="100" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Artifacts --> <mxCell id="artifacts" value="artifacts/
(stdout, stderr, job_events)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=10;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="210" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="e_py_runner" edge="1" source="setup_py" target="runner" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_runner_p1" edge="1" source="runner" target="p1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_p1_p2" edge="1" source="p1" target="p2" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_p2_p34" edge="1" source="p2" target="p34" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_p34_p57" edge="1" source="p34" target="p57" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_p57_p89" edge="1" source="p57" target="p89" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_p89_p1015" edge="1" source="p89" target="p1015" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_runner_art" edge="1" source="runner" target="artifacts" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_runner_art_l" value="output" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_runner_art"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
